description: National Physical Planning Department - Lahugala Magul Maha Viharaya as Sacred Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of a specific area of land (39.5121 hectares) as an "Urban Development Area" called "Lahugala Magul Maha Viharaya Sacred Area" under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It contains detailed land descriptions, lot numbers, boundaries, and survey information, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
